==== tluaMetatableClassTable.tlua (13 errors) ====
    // The checker reads a metatable's effect off the metamethods it states, so a
    // metatable must state them. A table that states none is reported at the
    // setmetatable call, with the fix, rather than typing the paired table as bare.
    
    local Point = {}
    Point.__index = Point
    function Point.len(self: table): number
        return 0
    end
    local p = setmetatable({ x = 1 }, Point)
    local length: number = p:len()
    
    -- A metamethod stated after the call still counts.
    local Late = {}
    local late = setmetatable({}, Late)
    function Late.describe(self: table): string
        return "late"
    end
    Late.__index = Late
    
    -- A table stating only other metamethods relates as before.
    local Named = { __tostring = function(self: table): string return "named" end }
    local n = setmetatable({}, Named)
    local weak = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    
    -- A table with no stated keys is not checked.
    local empty = setmetatable({}, {})
    local record = setmetatable({}, {} as Table<string, unknown>)
    
    -- A class table whose helper installs __index states no metamethod.
    local function inherit(cls: Table<string, unknown>)
        rawset(cls, "__index", cls)
    end
    local Helped = {}
    function Helped.len(self: table): number
        return 0
    end
    inherit(Helped)
    local helped = setmetatable({ x = 1 }, Helped)
                                           ~~~~~~
